analysis.title: Roper Technologies Inc. (ROP) 3Q26 takeaways: In-line quarter, raising estimates on below the line beat
key_insights: ROP reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $5.89 vs GS/FactSet consensus of $5.79/$5.79. 3Q segment EBITDA was $943 mn vs GS/FactSet consensus of $949/$940 mn, so the quarter was in line at the operating level and the EPS beat came below the line.
3Q26 organic growth was +7%, with +6% in Application Software (AS), +5% in Network Software (NS) and +10% in Technology Enabled Products (TEP).
ROP raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guide to $22.35-$22.40 from $22.15-$22.30, largely to account for the 3Q below-the-line beat. It guided 4Q26 EPS to $5.95-$6.00.
DAT growth accelerated on network expansion, higher ARPU and digital freight marketplace adoption. Management awaits stronger load volume before calling a broader freight recovery.
At Deltek, private sector strength continued and GovCon bookings were strong. Customers are increasingly interested in moving to the cloud despite an uncertain market.
ROP lowered its Neptune outlook: 2H revenue is now slightly down vs modest growth prior. The skew toward mechanical meters is likely to persist into 4Q and pressure revenue and margins.

On AI, management noted that 17-18 of 21 software businesses offer agentic solutions. AI-related bookings are ~75% of CentralReach bookings and ~25% of Aderant bookings, and gross margins are roughly in line with software.
GS raises FY26/FY27/FY28 EPS to $22.38/$24.75/$26.90 from $22.25/$24.25/$26.35, reflecting the EPS beat and lower interest expense.
GS stays Neutral and raises its 12-month price target to $468 from $410, based on higher estimates and a Q5-Q8 multiple of 15x (vs 14x prior). Upside to the $441.65 price is 6.0%.
GS cuts FY26/FY27/FY28 revenue estimates to $8,542.1mn/$8,970.1mn/$9,400.2mn from $8,586.0mn/$9,082.3mn/$9,517.8mn.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised its price target to $468 from $410 on higher EPS estimates and a Q5-Q8 multiple of 15x vs 14x prior. The rating stays Neutral, with 6.0% upside to $441.65.
